profile_text.body:
Lokalise is a continuous localization and translation management platform founded in 2016 and headquartered in Newark, Delaware. According to its website, the company integrates into development workflows to help teams ship localized products faster by bringing localization into one system that connects workflows, standardizes execution, and uses AI to deliver consistent, on-brand experiences across markets.

The company offers Lokalise AI, a localization AI product designed for continuous translation within developer workflows and hosted in the UK. The platform uses AI to apply approved terminology, tone of voice, and vocabulary to keep translations consistent with brand standards across languages. Lokalise dynamically selects and routes to the best-fit LLM based on language, content, and context without requiring repeated configuration, and it includes AI Scoring to evaluate translation quality automatically, routing only low-confidence results to human review. The platform provides role-based access control across its web interface and API.

Lokalise has a legal presence in Delaware with 18 cases tracked in that jurisdiction.
